title: Diagnostics configuration
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Frame-time watchdog thresholds for performance monitoring.

frame_time_warn_threshold_ms.description: Frame time threshold in milliseconds. Warn when frame time exceeds this value. Default: 33 ms (30 fps floor).

consecutive_frames_threshold.description: Number of consecutive frames exceeding threshold before emitting a WARN log message.
